# Deep Spec

Deep Spec is a mobile-first Progressive Web App for car owners who need to understand car parts from a camera scan. It is an AI car part finding helper with safety-first explanations for regular people.

## Important pages

- Home scanner: https://deepspec.app/
- AI car part finding guide: https://deepspec.app/articles/ai-car-part-finding.html
- AI car parts scanner guide: https://deepspec.app/articles/ai-car-parts-scanner.html
- Car damage AI scanner guide: https://deepspec.app/articles/car-damage-ai-scanner.html
- Visual AI inspection tools guide: https://deepspec.app/articles/visual-ai-inspection-tools.html

## Current product capabilities

- Rear-camera PWA scanner
- Smart reticle and stillness-based capture
- Gemini-backed AI identification through a server-side proxy
- Safety triage for better-photo and professional-verification cases
- Saved scan records with photo, AI result/error, category, training label, rating, correction, notes, and chat history
- Follow-up chat attached to saved scans

## Accuracy note

Deep Spec should not be described as a repair certification tool, exact OEM fitment database, or live pricing database. For brakes, steering, suspension, fuel, airbags, electrical burning, severe leaks, or unclear high-risk damage, Deep Spec should tell users to check the issue before driving or repairing.
